summary_for_children: Surah An-Nur teaches good manners in the home and in society: asking permission before entering, modesty, and not spreading rumours. It describes Allah's light with the beautiful example of a lamp in a niche.
environment_concept: Doors that open after greeting (24:27), a glass lamp in a niche like a bright star (24:35), a blessed olive grove (24:35), a mirage plain (24:39), a dark sea (24:40) and birds with spread wings (24:41).
architecture_and_scenery: Courtyard house with closed doors that open only after greeting, a central niche with a glass lamp, an olive grove, a shimmering mirage plain and a stormy night sea.

palette.lighting: One radiant lamp, warm interior glow; outside, harsh mirage light and deep sea darkness
palette.atmosphere: Still indoors; heat haze and thunder outside

areas.name: Doors of Permission
areas.description: Doors that open only after the player greets and asks.

areas.name: The Lamp in the Niche
areas.description: A glass lamp like a bright star in a wall niche.

areas.name: Blessed Olive Grove
areas.description: An olive grove neither of the east nor the west.

areas.name: Mirage Plain
areas.description: A desert where water appears but is not there.

activities.name: Knock and greet
activities.description: Practise asking permission at each door before entering.

activities.name: Stop the rumour

narration_plan: Narration is gentle and practical, linking each room to a manner from the surah.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
